---
title: Solution references
author: Mickaël Canouil
date: 2026-11-13
format:
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
    type: workshop
    session:
      number: 2
      total: 7
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A reference to a solution inside another solution, and a citation list of solutions, link to each solution with its label and no warning, in the HTML page, the deck and the PDF handout with the solutions at the end.
    mcanouil-html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['builds on <a href="#sol-a" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.1</a>', 'Compare <a href="#sol-b" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.2</a>, <a href="#sol-a" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.1</a> before']
        - ['\?@sol-']
    mcanouil-revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['builds on <a href="#/sol-a" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.1</a>', 'Compare <a href="#/sol-b" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.2</a>, <a href="#/sol-a" class="quarto-xref">Solution 2\.1</a> before']
        - ['\?@sol-']
    mcanouil-typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['builds on #link\(<sol-a>\)\[Solution 2\.1\]', 'Compare #link\(<sol-b>\)\[Solution 2\.2\], #link\(<sol-a>\)\[Solution 2\.1\] before', '#mc-ws-solution-heading\("Solution 2\.2"\) <sol-b>']
        - ['\?@sol-']
---
